verdict.rationale: Together AI's docs clearly document function/tool calling with structured JSON outputs and explicit support for chaining tool calls within a turn (multi-step) and across turns (multi-turn) to build agent loops, which covers much of the story. However, the evidence never explicitly confirms parallel tool-call support (only sequential multi-step chaining is described), and there is no independent/hands-on benchmark showing reliability of tool-calling fidelity across open models in practice. Missing for 10: explicit parallel tool-calling documentation, independent verification/benchmarks of tool-call reliability on open models, and real-world agent-loop case studies.
